# SourceSteward Ready control

Inactive owner-channel repository. No activation is installed.
inactive_initialization_proposed.scope: Optional exact reviewed initialization within P01; no activation, workflow, executor or credential

publisher_app.additional_read_permissions: unknown; require demonstrated necessity and separate exact permission approval
publisher_app.webhook_delivery: disabled; target native Actions events proposed
publisher_app.private_key_material: never included in proposal or agent output

credential_custody.deployment_ref_policy_proposed: custom branch main only; no tag policy

activation.write_and_reevaluation: One exact approved P10 operation may include bounded blocking, channel write and reevaluation; no authority granted here

operation_slices.operation: Create public repository wstein/sourcesteward-ready-control, optionally with the exact reviewed inactive README initialization
operation_slices.effect: One useful repository-creation operation may include repository creation and the approved initial main commit; no activation file, workflow, App installation or collaborator grant
operation_slices.prerequisite: Independent proposal review; owner identity/name availability; approval specifies empty or exact README initialization bytes/hash and all creation/initial-commit effects
steps: Confirm operating owner and exact repository-name availability within approved scope
If included in approval, create initial main commit with only the exact reviewed README bytes
Read back immutable repository ID/owner/visibility and, when included, exact main commit/tree/README bytes
operation_slices.failure: Stop and report partial creation/initialization with observed IDs; no automatic deletion, alternative name or active configuration

operation_slices.operation: Register owner-account App SourceSteward Ready with the listed proposed permissions
operation_slices.effect: One App registration only; webhook disabled; no installation, key generation, OAuth grant or settings change
operation_slices.prerequisite: Independent proposal review; owner/available name and exact form permission confirmation; unresolved permission extension requires new approval

operation_slices.operation: Install the exact newly observed App on target repository 1420737180 only
operation_slices.effect: One installation grant; control repository excluded; no key generation or check publication
operation_slices.prerequisite: Actual App ID/owner/permission readback and separately approved exact installation selection

operation_slices.operation: Create and configure no-secret target environment stw-ready-publisher for main branch only
operation_slices.effect: One useful environment operation includes creation, custom-only branch-policy mode and one main branch policy; no key/secret, deployment, tag policy or workflow
operation_slices.prerequisite: Independent review; operating owner/target ID; exact name absent; supported policy shape and approved actor/custody assessment; approval enumerates all three writes and readbacks
steps: Preflight operating owner identity, exact target ID and complete authorized environment-name metadata; stop on unknown scope/completeness, existing name or identity mismatch; a 404 alone does not prove absence
Create environment without secrets; read back new ID and initial protection state
Set custom deployment-branch-policy mode while preserving observed unrelated protections; read back exact environment policy
Create only main branch deployment policy; read back complete bounded branch-policy set and environment mode
operation_slices.bounds: At most 3 fixed preflight metadata reads (operating identity, target repository, bounded complete environment list), 3 mutation requests and 3 post-write readback requests; no retries or pagination beyond the approved complete bound
operation_slices.failure: Stop on unexpected state, denied/ambiguous response or failed readback; retain no-secret/nonactivated partial environment and report confirmed/unconfirmed steps; no automatic deletion or credential release

operation_slices.operation: Generate one private key for the exact App into owner-controlled custody
operation_slices.effect: One key generation; no agent-visible value, environment secret, installation expansion or publisher execution
operation_slices.prerequisite: Actual App identity and owner custody/rotation plan; separate explicit approval

operation_slices.operation: Add the owner-held key as environment secret STW_READY_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
operation_slices.effect: One secret write only; no value in review receipts; no automatic workflow dispatch or activation
operation_slices.prerequisite: Immutable executor/source and custody acceptance, effective source-root guards, controlled startup, actual environment/key identities; separately approved secret operation

operation_slices.operation: Apply one exact current-to-proposed review-evidence source-pinned requirement diff
operation_slices.effect: One separately reviewed settings operation preserving all current requirements; not executable from this proposal
operation_slices.prerequisite: Actual passing exact-source check and App ID, authorized security acceptance, current rules/settings and rollback diff; all currently unknown

operation_slices.operation: Activate one exact reviewed lock with bounded blocking, channel write and affected-key reevaluation
operation_slices.effect: One useful activation operation explicitly includes locking, confirmed invalidation, exact channel commit, resampling and reevaluation/publication for the approved key set; no settings change, build or executor installation
operation_slices.prerequisite: Actual channel ID/current commit, complete lock/policy/checker pins, old-baseline transition, accepted immutable executor/custody, exact raw-byte diff and complete bounded affected-key set; every write/readback and publication effect included in approval
steps: Validate old generation, exact candidate/new lock and complete at-most-20-key set; reject if the complete lifecycle cannot fit approved budgets
Acquire existing shared-key ownership in lexical key order; invalidate owned successes and confirm blocking readback before channel change
Commit only exact approved activation bytes under expected old branch/commit precondition; read back channel identity/commit/full raw bytes
Reevaluate affected keys with existing before/after full activation and association samples; publish/read back only current complete outcomes
Release ownership and report each confirmed or uncertain state; no old payload replay
operation_slices.bounds: Existing publisher limits: 60 seconds/120 total requests, at most 20 mutations and 20 readbacks; CLI 30-second/80-request sub-budget; at most 20 known keys, and fewer when required by the global budget; no polling/retries
operation_slices.failure: No channel write before confirmed blocking; after cancellation, partial commit, drift or uncertain write retain confirmed blocking and report enforcement-unknown for unconfirmed keys; never restore stale successes or automatically roll back channel
